members.speakLineZh: 把排除藏在腳註是假惺惺。

members.senseAnchor: lacking worldly experience and understanding, simple and guileless
members.speakLineEn: A naive model ignored clustering.

members.senseAnchor: not straightforward or candid; giving a false appearance of frankness; - David Cannadine; marked by skill in achieving a desired end especially with cunning or craft

members.speakLineZh: 狡猾措辭可不說謊卻誤導。

members.speakLineEn: Guileless reporting lists all deviations.
members.speakLineZh: 無心機報告列出全部偏離。

members.speakLineEn: Crafty selective quoting distorts reviews.
members.speakLineZh: 狡猾選擇性引用扭曲評論。

members.speakLineEn: Resourceful debugging is not p-hacking.
members.speakLineZh: 足智除錯不是 p 操弄。

members.speakLineEn: Simpleminded averages hide subgroup harm.
members.speakLineZh: 頭腦簡單的平均掩蓋次群傷害。

members.speakLineEn: A sophisticated design still needs plain summary.
members.speakLineZh: 精巧設計仍需白話摘要。

clusters.script: imply 暗示（說者）↔ infer 推論（聽者）。averse 厭惡 ↔ adverse 不利。discrete 分離 ↔ discreet 謹慎。censor 審查 ↔ censure 譴責。incredible 難以置信（事）↔ incredulous 不信（人）已在 cred 族。appraise 估價 ↔ apprise 通知。allude 暗指 ↔ elude 躲避。
pitfalls: 每對只差拼寫／角色，造句先問『誰做動作』
discrete 常用於數學／類別分離

members.speakLineEn: Does the abstract imply causality it did not identify?
members.speakLineZh: 摘要是否暗示未識別的因果？

members.speakLineEn: Risk-averse editors may over-weight novelty.
members.speakLineZh: 厭惡風險的編輯可能過度看重新奇。

members.speakLineEn: Use discrete categories only if theoretically clean.
members.speakLineZh: 唯有理論乾淨才用離散類別。

members.senseAnchor: marked by prudence or modesty and wise self-restraint; unobtrusively perceptive and sympathetic
members.speakLineEn: Be discreet with identifiable qualitative excerpts.
members.speakLineZh: 可識別質性摘錄要謹慎。

members.senseAnchor: someone who censures or condemns; a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
members.speakLineEn: Do not censor inconvenient robustness failures.
members.speakLineZh: 不要審查掉不便的穩健失敗。

members.speakLineEn: Public censure should follow due process.
members.speakLineZh: 公開譴責應經正當程序。

members.senseAnchor: evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of; consider in a comprehensive way
members.speakLineEn: Appraise study quality with a rubric, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 用量表評估研究品質，不要靠感覺。

members.senseAnchor: inform (somebody) of something; make aware of
members.speakLineEn: Apprise coauthors of all deviations promptly.
members.speakLineZh: 及時通知共同作者所有偏離。

members.senseAnchor: make a more or less disguised reference to
members.speakLineEn: Allude to related work without dumping twenty names.
members.speakLineZh: 暗指相關研究，不要傾倒二十人名。

members.senseAnchor: escape, either physically or mentally; be incomprehensible to; escape understanding by
members.speakLineEn: A clear write-up should not elude non-specialists entirely.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚寫作不該完全讓非專家看不懂。

members.speakLineEn: State the theoretical perspective up front.
members.speakLineZh: 先說理論視角。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer prospective registration when feasible.
members.speakLineZh: 可行時寧用前瞻註冊。

members.zhGloss: 歷史性的；有歷史意義的
members.senseAnchor: 歷史性的；有歷史意義的
members.speakLineEn: A historic leak is still one case.
members.speakLineZh: 歷史性洩漏仍是單案。

members.speakLineEn: Provide historical context for the measure.
members.speakLineZh: 為測量提供歷史脈絡。

members.senseAnchor: open to corrupt influence and especially bribery
members.speakLineEn: Venal incentives corrupt peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 貪贓誘因腐化同儕審查。

members.senseAnchor: warranting only temporal punishment; easily excused or forgiven
members.speakLineEn: A venial typo is not research misconduct.
members.speakLineZh: 可恕的打字錯誤不是研究不端。

clusters.hook: 字首 bene＝好、mal＝壞——同一機器兩種開關。
clusters.script: benevolent 好心腸；benefactor 做好事的金主；benign 良性／和善。對面：malign 惡意中傷，malicious 惡意的，malady 病痛，malfeasance 瀆職惡行，malevolent 惡意的。記法：bene～benefit；mal～malice。

members.senseAnchor: intending or showing kindness; showing or motivated by sympathy and understanding and generosity
members.speakLineEn: A benevolent funder still demands transparency.
members.speakLineZh: 仁慈金主仍要求透明。

members.speakLineEn: Not every anomaly is benign.
members.speakLineZh: 不是每個異常都良性。

members.speakLineEn: Beneficent defaults nudge better sharing.
members.speakLineZh: 有益預設推動更好共享。

members.speakLineEn: Do not malign critics to dodge critique.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用誹謗評論者來躲避批評。

members.speakLineEn: Malicious compliance with disclosure can still mislead.
members.speakLineZh: 惡意合規披露仍可能誤導。

members.speakLineEn: P-hacking is a systemic malady.
members.speakLineZh: p 操弄是系統性弊病。

members.speakLineEn: Research malfeasance triggers institutional review.
members.speakLineZh: 研究瀆職觸發機構審查。

members.speakLineEn: Assume error before assuming malevolent intent.
members.speakLineZh: 先假設錯誤再假設歹毒意圖。

members.speakLineEn: Who benefits from opacity?
members.speakLineZh: 誰從不透明受益？

members.speakLineEn: Statistical malpractice includes undisclosed fishing.
members.speakLineZh: 統計不當執業包含未揭露淘篩。

members.senseAnchor: corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality; lower in value by increasing the base-metal content

members.speakLineZh: 別把同儕審查貶成計分秀。

members.speakLineEn: Underpowered designs deplete trust.
members.speakLineZh: 低檢定力設計耗盡信任。

members.speakLineZh: 嘲弄想法而非人身——但仍核對數學。

members.senseAnchor: violate the sacred character of a place or language; remove the consecration from a person or an object
members.speakLineEn: Desecrate open science by gaming badges.
members.speakLineZh: 用刷徽章褻瀆開放科學。

members.senseAnchor: prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening; turn from a straight course, fixed direction, or line of interest
members.speakLineEn: Do not deflect critique with credentials.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用資歷轉移批評。

members.speakLineEn: A despondent team still owes accurate logs.
members.speakLineZh: 沮喪團隊仍欠準確日誌。

members.senseAnchor: to reveal the true nature of
members.speakLineEn: Debunk myths with registered replications.
members.speakLineZh: 用註冊複現揭穿迷思。

members.senseAnchor: charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
members.speakLineEn: Do not defame whistleblowers.
members.speakLineZh: 不要誹謗吹哨者。

members.speakLineEn: Denounce fabricated figures publicly.
members.speakLineZh: 公開譴責偽造圖。

members.speakLineEn: Missing data can depress estimated effects.
members.speakLineZh: 缺失資料可能壓低估計效應。

members.speakLineEn: Hidden exclusions devalue a dataset.
members.speakLineZh: 隱藏排除貶低資料集。

members.speakLineEn: Do not disparage fields you have not read.
members.speakLineZh: 不要貶低你沒讀過的領域。

members.speakLineEn: Good mentoring can dissuade fraudulent shortcuts.
members.speakLineZh: 好指導能勸阻造假捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: Write a dispassionate methods critique.

members.speakLineEn: Discord between prereg and paper needs explanation.

members.speakLineEn: Code in disarray hides silent bugs.

members.speakLineZh: 炒作會加重不信任。

members.speakLineZh: 新資料可為被棄假說免罪。

members.senseAnchor: to prove that someone is not guilty
members.speakLineEn: A checklist does not exculpate fraud.
members.speakLineZh: 檢核表不開脫造假。

members.senseAnchor: a passage selected from a larger work; take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy
members.speakLineEn: Quote the excerpt in context.
members.speakLineZh: 摘錄要帶語境。

members.senseAnchor: the price is much higher than it should be
members.speakLineEn: Exorbitant APC fees block equity.
members.speakLineZh: 過分高的開放費阻礙公平。

members.speakLineEn: Extol rigor more than brand names.

members.senseAnchor: release (a liquid) in drops or small quantities; make apparent by one's mood or behavior

members.speakLineZh: 共享前抹去識別資訊。

members.speakLineEn: Do not externalize blame for sloppy logs.

members.speakLineEn: A strong predictor is not automatically a cause.

members.speakLineEn: Dictatorial lab culture suppresses error reports.

members.speakLineZh: 我們如何進行訪談會形塑答案。

members.speakLineZh: 情節把讀者從主論點拐走。（比喻用法需謹慎）

members.speakLineEn: Public reports should educate without condescending.

members.speakLineEn: The aqueduct metaphor describes knowledge pipelines.

members.speakLineZh: 一座引文高架橋連接了遙遠領域。

members.speakLineEn: The deduction follows only if the premise holds.

members.speakLineEn: Elegant prose can seduce readers past weak evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 優美文筆可能誘使讀者略過薄弱證據。

members.speakLineEn: Ductile institutions adapt without breaking.
members.speakLineZh: 具延展性的制度能適應而不破裂。

members.speakLineZh: 有效率估計量不自動無偏。

members.speakLineZh: 充分統計量為參數無損壓縮。

members.speakLineEn: Reviewers prefer precise claims over sweeping ones.
members.speakLineZh: 審稿人寧可要精確主張。

members.speakLineZh: 小組將在宣布排名前商議。

members.speakLineEn: Please refer to the appendix for full tables.

members.speakLineEn: The paper offers a narrower mechanism than advertised.

members.senseAnchor: a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection; present for acceptance or rejection
members.speakLineEn: Counsel proffered an alternative reading of the clause.
members.speakLineZh: 律師正式提出另一種解讀。

members.speakLineEn: A fertile debate generated testable hypotheses.
members.speakLineZh: 多產辯論產生可檢驗假說。

members.speakLineEn: Metrics proliferate when incentives reward counting.
members.speakLineZh: 誘因獎勵計數時指標激增。

members.speakLineEn: Experts differ on how to weight outliers.
members.speakLineZh: 專家對極端值加權有分歧。

members.speakLineEn: An indifferent public still shapes turnout math.
members.speakLineZh: 冷漠公眾仍形塑投票率。

members.speakLineEn: The design will suffer if power is too low.
members.speakLineZh: 檢定力太低，設計會受苦。

members.speakLineEn: A referendum cannot replace careful cost analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 公投不能取代成本分析。

members.speakLineEn: Stay within the circumference of the defined construct.
members.speakLineZh: 停留在構念圓周內。

members.speakLineZh: 最終分析應對齊預註冊集合。

members.speakLineEn: Finish robustness before press quotes.
members.speakLineZh: 新聞稿前先完成穩健檢查。

members.speakLineEn: Attention is finite; prioritize claims.
members.speakLineZh: 注意力有限；排序主張。

members.speakLineEn: Infinite flexibility makes false positives infinite too.
members.speakLineZh: 無限彈性也讓假陽性無限。

members.speakLineEn: Define success criteria before launch.
members.speakLineZh: 啟動前定義成功標準。

members.speakLineEn: Refine the codebook after pilot disagreements.
members.speakLineZh: 試點分歧後精煉編碼簿。

members.speakLineEn: Confine exploratory plots to a sandbox.
members.speakLineZh: 探索圖關在沙盒內。

members.senseAnchor: a habitual attraction to some activity or thing
members.speakLineEn: Affinity for a theory can bias coding.
members.speakLineZh: 對理論的親近感會偏差編碼。

members.speakLineEn: Who finances the trial must be disclosed.

members.senseAnchor: the closing part, scene, or number

members.speakLineZh: 終章應重申限制，而非炒作。

members.speakLineEn: No single study is definitive.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有單一研究具決定性。

members.speakLineEn: Indefinite postponement kills accountability.
members.speakLineZh: 無限期延期殺死課責。

members.speakLineEn: Treat editorial finality as provisional.
members.speakLineZh: 把編輯定局當暫定。

members.speakLineEn: Each refinement should be logged.
members.speakLineZh: 每次精煉應記錄。

members.speakLineEn: Unfinished robustness is unfinished science.
members.speakLineZh: 未完成穩健＝未完成科學。

members.speakLineZh: 刪掉摘要裡多餘形容詞。

members.speakLineEn: Mellifluous prose can hide weak identification.

members.speakLineEn: Disclose funding influence on framing.
members.speakLineZh: 揭露資助對框架的影響。

members.speakLineEn: Policy reflux followed the failed pilot.

members.speakLineEn: Open tools can transform lab habits.

members.speakLineEn: Fortify claims with robustness checks.
members.speakLineZh: 用穩健檢查加固主張。

members.senseAnchor: strength of mind that enables one to endure adversity with courage
members.speakLineEn: Replication work takes quiet fortitude.
members.speakLineZh: 複現工作需要安靜的剛毅。

members.speakLineEn: A fortuitous sample is not a design.
members.speakLineZh: 偶然樣本不是設計。

members.senseAnchor: an asset of special worth or utility; (music) loud
members.speakLineEn: Transparency is this lab's forte.
members.speakLineZh: 透明是這實驗室的強項。

members.speakLineEn: Do not turn your theory into an unfalsifiable fortress.
members.speakLineZh: 別把理論建成不可證偽要塞。

members.speakLineEn: Method fortification includes preregistration.
members.speakLineZh: 方法強化包含預註冊。

members.speakLineEn: Report effort spent on data cleaning.
members.speakLineZh: 報告花在資料清理的努力。

members.speakLineEn: Comfort with ambiguity marks mature science.
members.speakLineZh: 能安於模糊標記成熟科學。

members.speakLineEn: Forceful claims need forceful evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 有力主張需要有力證據。

members.speakLineEn: Enforce sharing policies consistently.
members.speakLineZh: 一致地強制執行共享政策。

members.speakLineEn: Negative results can reinforce theory bounds.
members.speakLineZh: 陰性結果可加強理論邊界。

members.speakLineEn: A comforting narrative is not a proof.
members.speakLineZh: 令人安慰的敘事不是證明。

members.senseAnchor: produced or growing in extreme abundance
members.speakLineEn: Profuse acknowledgments cannot replace methods detail.
members.speakLineZh: 大量誌謝不能取代方法細節。

members.speakLineEn: Effusive praise in reviews can hide critique.
members.speakLineZh: 洋溢讚美可能掩蓋批評。

members.speakLineEn: Diffuse aims produce unfocused papers.
members.speakLineZh: 目標冗散產出失焦論文。

members.speakLineEn: Do not confuse significance with importance.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把顯著性與重要性混淆。

members.speakLineEn: Refuse silent outcome switching.
members.speakLineZh: 拒絕沉默更換結局變項。

members.speakLineEn: Anxiety can suffuse a lab after a retraction.
members.speakLineZh: 撤稿後焦慮可瀰漫實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Transfuse lessons from failed trials into protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 把失敗試驗教訓輸進規程。

members.speakLineEn: Interdisciplinary fusion needs shared measures.
members.speakLineZh: 跨領域融合需要共享測量。

members.speakLineEn: An infusion of new coders needs training.
members.speakLineZh: 新編碼員注入需要訓練。

members.speakLineEn: Document refusal rates in surveys.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄調查拒絕率。

members.speakLineEn: Category confusion inflates error bars.
members.speakLineZh: 類別混淆膨脹誤差。

clusters.hook: 字根 gen＝生、種——產房專管「生出什麼」。
clusters.script: congenital 一生下來就帶著；progeny 是子孫產線。ingenious 巧思生出妙招，ingenuous 天真得像剛出生。homogeneous 同種，heterogeneous 雜種混生；engender 催生出結果，genesis 起源故事，genealogy 家譜，genocide 滅種暴行。
reviewHooks: ingenious 巧妙 ≠ ingenuous 天真
pitfalls: congenital 先天 ≠ congenital 勿寫成 congential

members.senseAnchor: present at birth but not necessarily hereditary; acquired during fetal development
members.speakLineEn: Congenital defects need early screening.
members.speakLineZh: 先天缺陷需要早期篩檢。

members.senseAnchor: the immediate descendants of a person
members.speakLineEn: Ideas leave intellectual progeny in later papers.
members.speakLineZh: 想法在後續論文留下思想後代。

members.speakLineEn: An ingenious design saved sample size.
members.speakLineZh: 巧妙設計省下樣本量。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by an inability to mask your feelings; not devious; lacking in sophistication or worldliness
members.speakLineEn: Her ingenuous question exposed the hidden assumption.
members.speakLineZh: 她率直的問題揭開隱藏假設。

members.speakLineEn: A homogeneous sample limits external validity.
members.speakLineZh: 同質樣本限制外部效度。

members.speakLineEn: Heterogeneous effects hide in average treatment effects.
members.speakLineZh: 異質效應藏在平均處理效應裡。

members.speakLineEn: Ambiguous rubrics engender grading disputes.
members.speakLineZh: 模糊評分規準催生爭議。

members.senseAnchor: a coming into being; the first book of the Old Testament: tells of Creation; Adam and Eve; the Fall of Man; Cain and Abel; Noah and the flood; God's covenant with Abraham; Abraham and Isaac; Jacob and Esau; Joseph and his brothers
members.speakLineEn: The genesis of the theory was a failed replication.
members.speakLineZh: 該理論起源於一次失敗複現。

members.senseAnchor: successive generations of kin; the study or investigation of ancestry and family history
members.speakLineEn: A genealogy of methods shows forgotten branches.
members.speakLineZh: 方法系譜顯示被遺忘的分支。

members.speakLineEn: The term genocide carries legal and moral weight.
members.speakLineZh: 種族滅絕一詞具有法律與道德重量。

members.speakLineEn: Generic advice rarely fits local constraints.
members.speakLineZh: 通用建議很少符合在地限制。

members.speakLineEn: Indigenous knowledge can correct outsider models.
members.speakLineZh: 本土知識能校正外來模型。

members.speakLineZh: 把探索與驗證分析隔離。

members.speakLineZh: 同時報告總體與次群效應。

members.speakLineZh: 過分選擇性報告招致處罰。

members.speakLineEn: The congregation of stakeholders delayed the protocol.

members.speakLineEn: Desegregate methods training across departments.

members.speakLineZh: 聚合指標可能掩蓋傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Outcome segregation by gender needs justification.
members.speakLineZh: 依性別隔離結局需理由。

members.speakLineEn: Each congregant signed a conflict form.
members.speakLineZh: 每位成員簽署利益衝突表。

members.speakLineEn: The figure was egregiously cropped.

members.senseAnchor: the quality of being gregarious--having a dislike of being alone

clusters.hook: 字根 grad/gress＝走、步——誰進步誰退步看腳步。
clusters.script: 社會要 progress 向前走；失敗就 regress 退步。aggressive 人步步進逼，digress 演講走歪路。congress 走到一起開會；egress 是出口那一步。grade 是階梯等級，gradual 一步一步。

members.speakLineEn: Progress requires measurable milestones.
members.speakLineZh: 進步需要可測量的里程碑。

members.senseAnchor: the reasoning involved when you assume the conclusion is true and reason backward to the evidence; returning to a former state
members.speakLineEn: Under stress, teams may regress to safer routines.
members.speakLineZh: 壓力下團隊可能退回更安全的例行做法。

members.speakLineEn: Aggressive coding can introduce new bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 過度積極的編碼可能引入新錯誤。

members.senseAnchor: lose clarity or turn aside especially from the main subject of attention or course of argument in writing, thinking, or speaking; wander from a direct or straight course
members.speakLineEn: Let me digress briefly, then return to the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 容我短暫離題，再回到主張。

members.speakLineEn: The congress of specialists produced a joint statement.
members.speakLineZh: 專家大會產出了聯合聲明。

members.speakLineEn: Clear egress routes are part of lab safety.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚的出口動線是實驗室安全的一部分。

members.speakLineEn: We grade evidence by design quality, not by hype.
members.speakLineZh: 我們依設計品質評分證據，而非依炒作。

members.speakLineEn: Change was gradual rather than revolutionary.
members.speakLineZh: 改變是逐漸的，而非革命性的。

members.speakLineEn: Noise can degrade signal quality.
members.speakLineZh: 噪音會降低訊號品質。

members.speakLineEn: The policy looks retrograde by current standards.
members.speakLineZh: 以現行標準看，該政策顯得倒退。

members.senseAnchor: to fail to keep the rule
members.speakLineEn: To transgress the protocol voids the trial.
members.speakLineZh: 逾越協議會使試驗無效。

clusters.script: 反對就 reject 扔回去；意見 inject 注射進去。計劃 project 向前投射，猜測是 conjecture。eject 彈射出去，subject 被扔在權下，object 扔出異議。abject 被扔到最低處，trajectory 是拋物線軌道。

members.speakLineZh: 審查者可能因設計缺陷駁回論文。

members.speakLineEn: Inject one clarifying example into the paragraph.
members.speakLineZh: 在段落中注入一個澄清例子。

members.speakLineEn: Do not project motives without evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有證據就不要投射動機。

members.speakLineEn: The conclusion is still conjecture, not proof.
members.speakLineZh: 結論仍是臆測，不是證明。

members.speakLineEn: Security ejected disruptors from the hall.
members.speakLineZh: 保全把搗亂者驅離會場。

members.speakLineEn: Subjects were randomly assigned to conditions.
members.speakLineZh: 受試者被隨機分到各條件。

members.speakLineEn: Counsel objected to the leading question.

clusters.hook: 字根 mort＝死——登記處專管終點與瀕死。
clusters.script: mortal／mortality 會死與死亡率。immortal 不死。mortify 使羞愧欲死；moribund 瀕死。mortgage 抵押（把未來押死）；postmortem 事後檢討；mortuary 停屍間。
pitfalls: mortify 常＝使羞愧，不只「殺死」

members.speakLineEn: Even famous theories are mortal.
members.speakLineZh: 即使著名理論也會死。

members.speakLineEn: No dataset is immortal without curation.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有策展就沒有不朽資料集。

members.senseAnchor: the quality or state of being mortal; the ratio of deaths in an area to the population of that area; expressed per 1000 per year
members.speakLineEn: Report mortality with risk intervals.
members.speakLineZh: 報告死亡率請帶風險區間。

members.senseAnchor: practice self-denial of one's body and appetites; hold within limits and control
members.speakLineEn: Errors should mortify ego, not hide.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤應讓自我羞愧，而非隱藏。

members.senseAnchor: not growing or changing; without force or vitality; being on the point of death; breathing your last
members.speakLineEn: A moribund journal still holds archives.
members.speakLineZh: 瀕死期刊仍有檔案。

members.senseAnchor: a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan; put up as security or collateral
members.speakLineEn: Do not mortgage rigor for speed.
members.speakLineZh: 不要為速度抵押嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: Run a blameless postmortem on the failed launch.
members.speakLineZh: 對失敗上線做無責事後檢討。

members.speakLineEn: Treat retracted papers like a methods mortuary—learn, don't gossip.
members.speakLineZh: 把撤稿當方法停屍間：學習勿八卦。

members.speakLineEn: Seek immortality of methods, not of egos.
members.speakLineZh: 追求方法不朽而非自我不朽。

members.speakLineEn: An editor can play mortician for dead claims.
members.speakLineZh: 編輯可為死主張扮演殯葬者。

members.speakLineEn: A failed replication can be a deathblow to hype.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗複現可成炒作致命一擊。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid rigor mortis in outdated protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 避免過時規程像屍僵。

clusters.hook: 字根 mot/mov＝動——傳動軸專管誰在動、為何動。
clusters.script: motive／motivation 為何而動；emotion 心被帶動。promote 往前推升，demote 往下挪。remote 離得遠；locomotion 移動方式。commotion 一陣騷動；motile 能自己動。immutable 動不了改不了；mobilize 動員起來；momentous 一動就影響重大。
pitfalls: motive（動機）≠ motif（主題動機／圖案）

members.speakLineEn: State the motive for excluding outliers.
members.speakLineZh: 說明排除極端值的動機。

members.speakLineEn: Intrinsic motivation beats punitive grading.
members.speakLineZh: 內在動機勝過懲罰式評分。

members.speakLineEn: Emotion can bias risk perception.
members.speakLineZh: 情緒可能扭曲風險知覺。

members.speakLineEn: Open methods promote cumulative trust.
members.speakLineZh: 開放方法促進累積信任。

members.speakLineEn: A failed audit can demote a preferred model.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗稽核可把偏好模型降級。

members.speakLineEn: Remote sensing still needs ground truth.
members.speakLineZh: 遙感仍需地面實況。

members.speakLineEn: Measure locomotion errors in the robot trial.
members.speakLineZh: 量測機器人試驗的移動誤差。

members.speakLineEn: Online commotion is not evidence of effect size.
members.speakLineZh: 網路騷動不是效應量證據。

members.senseAnchor: one whose prevailing mental imagery takes the form of inner feelings of action; (of spores or microorganisms) capable of movement
members.speakLineEn: Motile cells complicate fixed imaging.
members.speakLineZh: 能動細胞讓固定成像變複雜。

members.speakLineEn: Treat timestamps as immutable once logged.
members.speakLineZh: 時間戳一經記錄即不可改。

members.speakLineEn: Mobilize reviewers early for adversarial checks.
members.speakLineZh: 及早動員審稿人做對抗檢查。

members.speakLineEn: A momentous protocol change needs versioning.
members.speakLineZh: 重大規程變更需要版本控管。

clusters.hook: 字根 neg＝否——開關室專管「關掉／否認」。
clusters.script: negate 直接否定；abnegate 自我否定放棄。renegade 背叛原陣營。negligent／negligible：疏忽 vs 可忽略的小量。renege 食言反悔；denigrate 抹黑貶低。negotiation 討價還價像半否定半妥協；negative 負面開關。
reviewHooks: negligent 疏忽 ≠ negligible 可忽略
pitfalls: negligent（疏忽的人／行為）≠ negligible（小到可忽略）

members.speakLineEn: One confound can negate the causal claim.
members.speakLineZh: 一個混淆變項能否掉因果主張。

members.senseAnchor: deny oneself (something); restrain, especially from indulging in some pleasure; surrender (power or a position)
members.speakLineEn: Leaders who abnegate credit build stronger teams.
members.speakLineZh: 放棄邀功的領導者能建更強團隊。

members.senseAnchor: one who rejects a religion, cause, allegiance, or group for another
members.speakLineEn: A renegade analyst published the null result.
members.speakLineZh: 變節分析者發表了虛無結果。

members.senseAnchor: failing to give proper attention or care
members.speakLineEn: Negligent storage of identifiers is a breach.
members.speakLineZh: 識別資料疏忽儲存即違規。

members.speakLineEn: The bias was negligible under sensitivity checks.
members.speakLineZh: 敏感度檢查下偏差可忽略。

members.senseAnchor: the mistake of not following suit when able to do so; fail to fulfill a promise or obligation
members.speakLineEn: Do not renege on data-sharing pledges.
members.speakLineZh: 不要對資料共享承諾食言。

members.senseAnchor: cause to seem less serious; play down; charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
members.speakLineEn: Do not denigrate qualitative work as soft.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把質性工作抹黑成「軟」。

members.speakLineEn: A negative finding still updates beliefs.
members.speakLineZh: 陰性發現仍更新信念。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological abnegation means dropping pet theories.
members.speakLineZh: 方法論克己意味放下寵物理論。

members.speakLineEn: Renegotiate authorship when roles change mid-project.
members.speakLineZh: 角色中途改變時重談作者權。

members.senseAnchor: a negative statement; a statement that is a refusal or denial of some other statement; the speech act of negating
members.speakLineEn: Logical negation flips the claim's truth value.
members.speakLineZh: 邏輯否定翻轉命題真值。

members.speakLineEn: Self-abnegation can hide coercive lab cultures.
members.speakLineZh: 過度克己可能掩蓋強制實驗室文化。

clusters.hook: 字根 nov＝新——發表會專管新東西與新手。
clusters.script: novel／novelty 新奇。innovate／innovation 創新。renovate 翻新；novice 新手。innovative 創新的；nova 新星。

members.speakLineEn: A novel measure needs validation.
members.speakLineZh: 新測量需要驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Novelty bias crowds out replication.
members.speakLineZh: 新奇偏差排擠複現。

members.speakLineEn: Innovate on sharing tools, not on hiding exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 在共享工具上創新，而非隱藏排除。

members.speakLineEn: Process innovation can cut error rates.
members.speakLineZh: 流程創新能降低錯誤率。

members.senseAnchor: restore to a previous or better condition; make brighter and prettier
members.speakLineEn: Renovate legacy code before scaling.
members.speakLineZh: 擴張前先翻新舊程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Novice analysts need checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 新手分析者需要檢核表。

members.speakLineEn: Innovative visualization still needs axes labeled.
members.speakLineZh: 創新視覺化仍需標軸。

members.speakLineEn: A media nova faded after critique.
members.speakLineZh: 媒體新星在批評後黯淡。

members.speakLineEn: Treat the first year as a novitiate in ethics.
members.speakLineZh: 把第一年當倫理見習期。

members.speakLineEn: Nouveau metrics need skeptical adoption.
members.speakLineZh: 新派指標需懷疑地採用。

members.speakLineEn: Renew consent when protocols change.
members.speakLineZh: 規程變更時更新同意。

members.senseAnchor: the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation; the act of renewing
members.speakLineEn: License renewal triggered an audit.
members.speakLineZh: 授權更新觸發稽核。

clusters.hook: 字根 nym/nomen＝名——更衣室專管掛什麼名牌。
clusters.script: anonymous 不掛名；pseudonym 掛假名。synonym 同義名牌，antonym 反義名牌。misnomer 叫錯名；ignominy 臭名。nominal 名義上的；renown 大名。nomenclature 整套命名系統；homonym 同音異義的撞名。

members.speakLineEn: Anonymous review can reduce status bias.
members.speakLineZh: 匿名審查可降低地位偏差。

members.speakLineEn: She published under a pseudonym to avoid retaliation.
members.speakLineZh: 她用筆名發表以免報復。

members.speakLineEn: A near synonym still shifts tone.
members.speakLineZh: 近義詞仍會改語氣。

members.speakLineEn: List the antonym to test if you grasp the scale.
members.speakLineZh: 列出反義詞以檢驗是否掌握尺度。

members.senseAnchor: a wrong use of a name
members.speakLineEn: Calling it a 'pilot' was a misnomer for a full trial.
members.speakLineZh: 稱為試點其實是完整試驗的誤稱。

members.speakLineEn: Fraud brings lasting ignominy to a lab.
members.speakLineZh: 造假給實驗室帶來長久恥辱。

members.senseAnchor: a phrase that can function as the subject or object of a verb; relating to or constituting or bearing or giving a name
members.speakLineEn: Nominal authorship without contribution is unethical.
members.speakLineZh: 無貢獻的掛名作者不倫理。

members.senseAnchor: the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed
members.speakLineEn: Renown should not exempt anyone from audit.
members.speakLineZh: 名望不該豁免稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Clarify nomenclature before coding categories.
members.speakLineZh: 編碼類別前先釐清命名。

members.speakLineEn: Homonyms confuse automated text classifiers.
members.speakLineZh: 同形異義詞困擾自動分類器。

members.speakLineEn: Define every acronym at first use.
members.speakLineZh: 每個縮寫首次出現要定義。

members.speakLineEn: Anonymity is hard once raw audio exists.
members.speakLineZh: 有原始音檔時匿名很難。

clusters.hook: 字根 path＝感、受苦——診所專治『感不感得到』。
clusters.script: apathy 是掛號也不想感；empathy 能感同身受，sympathy 隔床安慰。pathos 是催淚橋段，pathetic 可憐到讓人感嘆。antipathy 天生反感，pathogen 讓身體受苦的病原；homeopathy 等療法名也帶 path，但考試先抓住『感／病』核心。
reviewHooks: path＝感／苦：apathy 無感、empathy 同感、sympathy 同情、antipathy 反感
pitfalls: empathy（代入感受）vs sympathy（同情／憐憫）層次不同
pathetic 口語常貶，學術上也可指『引發悲憫』

members.senseAnchor: an absence of emotion or enthusiasm; the trait of lacking enthusiasm for or interest in things generally
members.speakLineEn: Voter apathy can mute even strong reforms.
members.speakLineZh: 選民冷漠能使再強的改革也消音。

members.senseAnchor: understanding and entering into another's feelings
members.speakLineEn: Empathy aids interviewing but does not replace coding rules.
members.speakLineZh: 同理心有助訪談，但不能取代編碼規則。

members.speakLineEn: Sympathy alone cannot allocate scarce beds.
members.speakLineZh: 單靠同情無法分配稀缺床位。

members.speakLineEn: The speech relied more on pathos than on proof.
members.speakLineZh: 演說更依賴悲愴感染而非證據。

members.senseAnchor: deserving or inciting pity; ; ; - Galsworthy; inspiring mixed contempt and pity
members.speakLineEn: A pathetic sample size cannot support the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 可憐的樣本數支撐不起該主張。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of intense dislike; the object of a feeling of intense aversion; something to be avoided
members.speakLineEn: Mutual antipathy stalled coalition talks.
members.speakLineZh: 相互反感讓聯盟談判停滯。

members.speakLineEn: The model treats misinformation like a pathogen.
members.speakLineZh: 該模型把錯誤訊息當成病原體。

members.senseAnchor: the branch of medical science that studies the causes and nature and effects of diseases; any deviation from a healthy or normal condition
members.speakLineEn: Organizational pathology showed up as chronic delay.
members.speakLineZh: 組織病態表現為長期拖延。

members.speakLineEn: Good editors are not telepathic; mark your claims.
members.speakLineZh: 好編輯不是心靈感應——請標明你的主張。

members.zhGloss: 反社會人格者（通俗用法）
members.senseAnchor: 反社會人格者（通俗用法）
members.speakLineEn: Popular media overuses “sociopath” as a slur.
members.speakLineZh: 大眾媒體過度把「sociopath」當罵人用語。

members.zhGloss: 順勢療法（名含 path；考構詞辨識）
members.senseAnchor: 順勢療法（名含 path；考構詞辨識）
members.speakLineEn: Etymology explains -pathy in homeopathy, but efficacy is a separate claim.
members.speakLineZh: 字源能解釋 homeopathy 裡的 -pathy，但療效是另一個命題。

clusters.hook: 字根 pel/puls＝推——被推走或被推動。
clusters.script: compel 強迫推動；expel 推出去；repel 推開。impulse 衝動推力，propel 向前推，dispel 驅散。pulse 脈搏，compel／compulsory 強制，expulsion 開除，repellent 令人反感，impel 驅使，pulsate 搏動。
pitfalls: repel 可指物理推開或令人反感

members.speakLineEn: Evidence should compel revision, not loyalty tests.
members.speakLineZh: 證據應強迫修正，而非忠誠測驗。

members.speakLineEn: Schools rarely expel for honest error, but silence does.
members.speakLineZh: 學校少因誠實錯誤開除，沉默卻會。

members.senseAnchor: cause to move back by force or influence; be repellent to; cause aversion in
members.speakLineEn: Opaque methods repel collaborators.
members.speakLineZh: 不透明方法讓合作者反感。

members.speakLineEn: Resist the impulse to peek at outcomes early.
members.speakLineZh: 忍住提早偷看結果的衝動。

members.senseAnchor: cause to move forward with force; give an incentive for action
members.speakLineEn: Clear stakes propel careful reading.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚利害推進細讀。

members.speakLineEn: Open data can dispel rumors of selective reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 開放資料能驅散選擇性報告謠言。

members.speakLineEn: Take the pulse of the literature with living reviews.
members.speakLineZh: 用持續評論為文獻把脈。

members.speakLineEn: Compulsory preregistration changes gaming incentives.
members.speakLineZh: 強制預註冊改變投機誘因。

members.senseAnchor: the act of forcing out someone or something; squeezing out by applying pressure
members.speakLineEn: Expulsion from a consortium should follow due process.
members.speakLineZh: 逐出聯盟應有正當程序。

members.speakLineEn: A repellent tone loses persuadable readers.
members.speakLineZh: 反感語氣失去可說服讀者。

members.senseAnchor: urge or force (a person) to an action; constrain or motivate; cause to move forward with force
members.speakLineEn: Curiosity should impel checks, not shortcuts.
members.speakLineZh: 好奇應驅使核查，而非捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: Attention pulsates with media cycles.
members.speakLineZh: 注意力隨媒體週期搏動。

members.senseAnchor: a propelling force; the act of propelling
members.speakLineEn: Citation propulsion is not the same as truth-tracking.
members.speakLineZh: 引用推進力≠追蹤真理。

members.senseAnchor: the force by which bodies repel one another; intense aversion
members.speakLineEn: Mutual repulsion between camps blocks synthesis.
members.speakLineZh: 陣營互斥阻礙綜整。

members.senseAnchor: an urge to do or say something that might be better left undone or unsaid; an irrational motive for performing trivial or repetitive actions, even against your will
members.speakLineEn: Under compulsion, consent is compromised.
members.speakLineZh: 強迫下同意已打折。

members.speakLineZh: 結果尚待倫理審查。

members.speakLineEn: Suspend recruitment when adverse events cluster.
members.speakLineZh: 不良事件群聚時暫停收案。

members.speakLineEn: Estimates depend on the exclusion restriction.
members.speakLineZh: 估計依賴排除限制。

members.speakLineEn: Independent replication beats in-house confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 獨立複現勝過內部確認。

members.speakLineEn: Append the codebook to the replication package.
members.speakLineZh: 把編碼簿附加到複現包。

members.speakLineEn: Put long tables in an appendix.
members.speakLineZh: 長表放附錄。

members.speakLineEn: Weighting can compensate for known nonresponse.
members.speakLineZh: 加權可補償已知不回應。

members.senseAnchor: administer or bestow, as in small portions; grant a dispensation; grant an exemption
members.speakLineEn: We can dispense with decorative citations.
members.speakLineZh: 我們可以免除裝飾性引用。

members.senseAnchor: thinking deeply about something that worries you
members.speakLineEn: A pensive tone is fine; vagueness is not.
members.speakLineZh: 沉思語氣可以；含糊不行。

members.senseAnchor: money paid out; an amount spent; the act of spending money for goods or services
members.speakLineEn: Track expenditure against preregistered milestones.
members.speakLineZh: 依預註冊里程碑追蹤支出。

members.speakLineEn: Pension systems illustrate long-horizon policy tradeoffs.
members.speakLineZh: 退休金制度說明長期政策取捨。

members.senseAnchor: a straight line at right angles to another line; a Gothic style in 14th and 15th century England; characterized by vertical lines and a four-centered (Tudor) arch and fan vaulting
members.speakLineEn: Keep axes perpendicular and honestly scaled.
members.speakLineZh: 軸線保持垂直且誠實刻度。

members.senseAnchor: be imminent or about to happen; close in time; about to occur
members.speakLineEn: Impending deadlines distort careful reading.
members.speakLineZh: 迫近截止扭曲細讀。

members.speakLineEn: A pendant caveat cannot rescue a broken design.
members.speakLineZh: 垂吊的但書救不了壞設計。

members.speakLineEn: Estimate propensity with covariates chosen ex ante.
members.speakLineZh: 用事先選好的共變估計傾向。

members.speakLineEn: The import of the finding is practical, not merely theoretical.
members.speakLineZh: 該發現的重要性是實務的。

members.speakLineEn: Methods that export poorly across cultures need local tests.
members.speakLineZh: 難跨文化輸出的方法需在地檢驗。

members.speakLineEn: The metaphor of deporting outliers can hide selection bias.
members.speakLineZh: 『驅逐極端值』可能掩蓋選擇偏差。

members.speakLineEn: A portable checklist travels between labs.
members.speakLineZh: 可移植檢核表能在實驗室間旅行。

members.senseAnchor: a state of overwhelming usually pleasurable emotion
members.speakLineEn: How we transport samples affects degradation.
members.speakLineZh: 樣本運輸方式影響降解。

members.speakLineEn: Important claims deserve pre-registered tests.
members.speakLineZh: 重要主張值得預註冊檢驗。

members.senseAnchor: suitable or at a time that is suitable or advantageous especially for a particular purpose
members.speakLineEn: An opportune pause let cooler evidence speak.
members.speakLineZh: 合時停頓讓冷靜證據說話。

members.speakLineEn: Missing data is also a missed opportunity for honesty.
members.speakLineZh: 缺漏資料也是錯失誠實機會。

members.speakLineEn: Correlations alone rarely support causal claims.
members.speakLineZh: 單靠相關很少支撐因果。

members.speakLineEn: Report effect sizes with intervals, not stars alone.
members.speakLineZh: 報告效應量請帶區間。

members.speakLineEn: A methods portfolio beats a single fashionable tool.
members.speakLineZh: 方法組合勝過單一流行工具。

members.senseAnchor: the intended meaning of a communication; the pervading meaning or tenor
members.speakLineEn: The statute purports to protect privacy broadly.
members.speakLineZh: 法條聲稱要廣泛保護隱私。

members.speakLineEn: That leap from survey to policy is insupportable.
members.speakLineZh: 從問卷跳到政策無法支撐。

members.speakLineEn: Think of operationalization as the porter of concepts.
members.speakLineZh: 操作型定義像概念搬運工。

members.zhGloss: 運動；炫耀（古義 disport 近）
members.senseAnchor: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition; the occupation of athletes who compete for pay
members.speakLineEn: Do not sport with definitions mid-argument.
members.speakLineZh: 論證中途不要拿定義嬉戲。

clusters.script: propose 放上桌；impose 強加。compose 組裝，dispose 處置，expose 揭露，oppose 對放反對。postpone 往後放；component 零件，positive 明確肯定，deposit 存放。juxtapose 並置，superimpose 疊加，proposition 命題，exponent 倡導者，repository 儲庫。

members.speakLineEn: We propose a preregistered analysis plan.
members.speakLineZh: 我們提議預註冊分析計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Do not impose a narrative the data cannot carry.
members.speakLineZh: 不要強加資料扛不起的敘事。

members.speakLineEn: Compose the abstract after results are stable.
members.speakLineZh: 結果穩定後再寫摘要。

members.speakLineEn: How labs dispose of failed trials shapes the literature.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗試驗怎麼處置形塑文獻。

members.speakLineEn: Replication can expose fragile findings.
members.speakLineZh: 複現能揭露脆弱發現。

members.speakLineEn: Stakeholders may oppose transparency that threatens rents.
members.speakLineZh: 利害關係人可能反對威脅租金的透明。

members.speakLineEn: Postpone celebration until robustness checks pass.
members.speakLineZh: 穩健檢查通過前先延期慶祝。

members.speakLineEn: Trust is a component of cumulative science.
members.speakLineZh: 信任是累積科學的元件。

members.speakLineEn: A positive result still needs a credible mechanism.
members.speakLineZh: 陽性結果仍需可信機制。

members.speakLineEn: Deposit raw files in a trusted repository.
members.speakLineZh: 原始檔存進可信儲庫。

members.speakLineEn: Juxtapose the two models to show the gap.
members.speakLineZh: 並置兩模型以顯示差距。

members.speakLineEn: A public repository reduces private hoarding of data.
members.speakLineZh: 公開儲庫減少私藏。

members.senseAnchor: (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false; a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
members.speakLineEn: State the proposition before you defend it.
members.speakLineZh: 先陳述命題再辯護。

members.speakLineEn: Do not superimpose ideology on measurement choices.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把意識形態疊加在測量上。

members.speakLineEn: An early exponent of open methods faced resistance.
members.speakLineZh: 開放方法早期倡導者遇阻力。

members.speakLineEn: A potent design still needs honest reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 強效設計仍需誠實報告。

members.speakLineEn: Unenforced policies are impotent.
members.speakLineZh: 不執行的政策無力。

members.speakLineEn: State the potential for harm explicitly.
members.speakLineZh: 明確陳述潛在傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Estimate the potency of the intervention.
members.speakLineZh: 估計介入效力。

members.speakLineEn: No statistician is omnipotent across designs.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有統計學家跨設計全能。

members.senseAnchor: a ruler who is unconstrained by law
members.speakLineEn: Do not let a single potentate gatekeep methods.
members.speakLineZh: 別讓單一掌權者把關方法。

members.speakLineEn: A plenipotentiary negotiator still needs counsel.
members.speakLineZh: 全權談判者仍需顧問。

members.speakLineEn: Map potentiality before claiming inevitability.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱必然前先畫潛能。

members.speakLineEn: Empower juniors to halt unsafe protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 賦權資淺者叫停不安全規程。

members.speakLineEn: Powerful computers do not excuse weak theory.
members.speakLineZh: 強大電腦不恕弱理論。

members.speakLineEn: Whistleblowers can feel powerless without policy.
members.speakLineZh: 無政策時吹哨者可感無力。

members.speakLineEn: Reject fantasies of methodological omnipotence.
members.speakLineZh: 拒絕方法全能幻想。

clusters.script: punctual 準點；puncture 刺破。punctilious 對細節一絲不苟；compunction 良心刺痛。punctuate 加標點／強調；punctuation 標點。acupuncture 針刺。

members.speakLineEn: Be punctual with correction notices.
members.speakLineZh: 勘誤通知要準時。

members.speakLineEn: One leak can puncture a privacy plan.
members.speakLineZh: 一次洩漏可刺破隱私計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Punctilious citation prevents ghost references.
members.speakLineZh: 一絲不苟引用防止幽靈文獻。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of guilt or regret
members.speakLineEn: Feel compunction about quiet exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 對沉默排除感到內疚。

members.speakLineEn: Punctuate limitations clearly.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚強調限制。

members.speakLineEn: Bad punctuation can scramble claims.
members.speakLineZh: 糟糕標點會打亂主張。

members.speakLineEn: Think of audits as methodological acupuncture—precise, not theatrical.
members.speakLineZh: 把稽核當方法針灸：精準不作秀。

members.speakLineEn: Ask pointed questions about missingness.
members.speakLineZh: 對缺失問尖銳問題。

members.speakLineEn: Pointless metrics waste cohorts.
members.speakLineZh: 無意義指標浪費世代。

members.speakLineEn: Appoint an independent data steward.
members.speakLineZh: 任命獨立資料管家。

members.speakLineEn: Overclaiming will disappoint readers later.
members.speakLineZh: 過度宣稱稍後令讀者失望。

members.speakLineEn: Offer a counterpoint in the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 在討論提供對位觀點。

members.speakLineZh: 好問審稿人抓到沉默排除。

members.senseAnchor: anything indispensable; necessary for relief or supply
members.speakLineEn: Statistical power is a requisite, not a luxury.
members.speakLineZh: 檢定力是必需，不是奢侈。

members.senseAnchor: an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right); a right reserved exclusively by a particular person or group (especially a hereditary or official right)
members.speakLineEn: Travel funds should not become a hidden perquisite.
members.speakLineZh: 差旅費不該變隱藏津貼。

members.speakLineEn: An ethics inquisition without due process backfires.
members.speakLineZh: 無正當程序的倫理審問會反噬。

members.speakLineEn: Acquire skills before acquiring expensive tools.
members.speakLineZh: 先習得技能再買昂貴工具。

members.speakLineEn: Relinquish control of randomization to a third party.
members.speakLineZh: 把隨機化控制交給第三方。

members.speakLineEn: Exquisite instruments still need dirty field tests.
members.speakLineZh: 精緻儀器仍需骯髒田野測試。

members.speakLineEn: Replication literacy is a prerequisite for meta-analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 複現素養是統合分析先決。

members.speakLineEn: Query the registry for unpublished trials.
members.speakLineZh: 向登錄庫查詢未發表試驗。

members.speakLineEn: The quest for significance warps designs.
members.speakLineZh: 追求顯著性會扭曲設計。

members.speakLineEn: Request raw data before accepting the narrative.
members.speakLineZh: 接受敘事前先請求原始資料。

members.speakLineEn: Open inquiry beats closed confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 開放探究勝過封閉確認。

members.speakLineEn: Disruptive claims need stronger evidence, not louder ads.

members.speakLineEn: Science advances by correcting itself.
members.speakLineZh: 科學靠自我校正前進。

members.speakLineEn: Be conscious of researcher degrees of freedom.
members.speakLineZh: 要意識到研究者自由度。

members.speakLineEn: A researcher's conscience should stop p-hacking.
members.speakLineZh: 研究者良心應阻止 p 值操弄。

members.senseAnchor: possessed of universal or complete knowledge
members.speakLineEn: No reviewer is omniscient across fields.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有審稿人跨領域全知。

members.senseAnchor: able to know what will happen in the future
members.speakLineEn: Her prescient warning about overfitting aged well.
members.speakLineZh: 她對過度擬合的先見經得起時間。

members.speakLineEn: Admit nescience rather than invent certainty.
members.speakLineZh: 承認無知勝過捏造確定。

members.speakLineEn: A plebiscite cannot replace technical review.
members.speakLineZh: 公投不能取代技術審查。

members.senseAnchor: lacking a conscience; greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
members.speakLineEn: Withholding adverse results is unconscionable.
members.speakLineZh: 隱瞞不良結果良心難安。

members.zhGloss: 不自在的；自我意識強的
members.senseAnchor: 不自在的；自我意識強的
members.speakLineEn: Self-conscious prose hides weak claims.
members.speakLineZh: 扭捏文風常掩蓋弱主張。

members.speakLineEn: Subconscious cues still need controlled tests.
members.speakLineZh: 潛意識線索仍需對照試驗。

members.speakLineEn: Claims of omniscience belong to theology, not labs.
members.speakLineZh: 全知宣稱屬神學不屬實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Scientific humility includes reporting limits.
members.speakLineZh: 科學謙遜包含報告限制。

clusters.script: describe 描寫，inscribe 刻寫進去，proscribe 明文禁止，prescribe 開處方／規定。script 劇本，manuscript 手稿，subscribe 署名訂閱，transcribe 轉寫，ascribe 歸因寫到誰頭上，circumscribe 劃界限制，scribble 亂寫，conscript 徵召寫入名單，postscript 又及。

members.speakLineEn: Describe the sampling frame before results.
members.speakLineZh: 結果前先描述抽樣架構。

members.speakLineEn: Values inscribed in charters need operational teeth.
members.speakLineZh: 憲章銘刻的價值需要可操作牙齒。

members.speakLineEn: The code proscribes dual submission.
members.speakLineZh: 規範禁止一稿兩投。

members.senseAnchor: say what medicine or treatment a sick person should have
members.speakLineEn: Guidelines prescribe reporting confidence intervals.
members.speakLineZh: 指引規定報告信賴區間。

members.speakLineEn: Preregistration is a script against flexible plotting.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊是對抗彈性畫圖的腳本。

members.speakLineEn: The manuscript should flag all deviations.
members.speakLineZh: 手稿應標明所有偏離。

members.speakLineEn: I cannot subscribe to that causal leap.
members.speakLineZh: 我無法附和那因果跳躍。

members.senseAnchor: write out from speech, notes, etc.; rewrite in a different script
members.speakLineEn: Transcribe interviews with speaker labels.
members.speakLineZh: 訪談轉寫請標說話者。

members.speakLineEn: Do not ascribe intent without evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 無證據不要歸因意圖。

members.speakLineEn: Budget rules circumscribe feasible designs.
members.speakLineZh: 預算規則限制可行設計。

members.speakLineEn: Margin scribbles are not a codebook.
members.speakLineZh: 頁邊亂寫不是編碼簿。

members.senseAnchor: someone who is drafted into military service; enroll into service compulsorily
members.speakLineEn: Do not conscript unrelated citations for decoration.
members.speakLineZh: 不要強徵無關引用當裝飾。

members.speakLineEn: A postscript cannot fix a broken identification strategy.
members.speakLineZh: 又及救不了壞的識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: A nondescript method section hides key choices.
members.speakLineZh: 平淡方法段會藏起關鍵選擇。

members.speakLineEn: Check superscripts in chemical and statistical notation.
members.speakLineZh: 檢查化學與統計記號上標。

members.speakLineEn: Sedentary designs miss real-world motion noise.
members.speakLineZh: 久坐式設計錯過真實移動噪音。

members.speakLineEn: Policy sediment accumulates from old rules.
members.speakLineZh: 舊規累積成政策沉澱。

members.speakLineEn: Authority should reside in transparent criteria.
members.speakLineZh: 權威應存在於透明標準。

members.speakLineEn: The society president disclosed funding ties.
members.speakLineZh: 學會主席揭露資助關係。

members.speakLineEn: Each coding session used a blinded codebook.
members.speakLineZh: 每次編碼時段使用盲法碼本。

members.speakLineEn: Do not obsess over a single p-threshold.
members.speakLineZh: 不要執念單一 p 門檻。

members.speakLineEn: Assiduous documentation prevents silent edits.
members.speakLineZh: 勤勉記錄防止沉默修改。

members.senseAnchor: causing harm in a way that is gradual or not easily noticed
members.speakLineEn: Insidious selection bias grows with convenience samples.
members.speakLineZh: 陰險選擇偏差隨便利樣本成長。

members.senseAnchor: an assistant subject to the authority or control of another; a company that is completely controlled by another company
members.speakLineEn: Report subsidiary analyses as exploratory.
members.speakLineZh: 附屬分析標為探索性。

members.senseAnchor: a person who dissents from some established policy; characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards
members.speakLineEn: Dissident findings deserve the same review rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 異議發現值得同等審查嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: The error may reside in measurement, not theory.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤可能在測量不在理論。

members.speakLineEn: An obsession with novelty crowds out replication.
members.speakLineZh: 嗜新執念排擠複現。

members.speakLineEn: Policy should not track online sentiment alone.
members.speakLineZh: 政策不該只追網路情緒。

members.speakLineEn: Document consent before data linkage.
members.speakLineZh: 資料連結前記錄同意。

members.speakLineEn: Does this operationalization make sense theoretically?
members.speakLineZh: 此操作化理論上說得通嗎？

members.speakLineEn: A sensible robustness check is cheap insurance.
members.speakLineZh: 明智穩健檢查是便宜保險。

members.speakLineEn: Results are sensitive to one influential point.
members.speakLineZh: 結果對一個影響點敏感。

members.speakLineEn: Sensory overload in dashboards hides the signal.
members.speakLineZh: 儀表板感官過載會藏訊號。

members.senseAnchor: feel bitter or indignant about; wish ill or allow unwillingly
members.speakLineEn: Teams resent uncredited labor on shared datasets.
members.speakLineZh: 團隊憤恨共享資料上未記名勞動。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of evil to come
members.speakLineEn: A presentiment of failure is not a stopping rule.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗預感不是停止規則。

members.senseAnchor: a person employed to keep watch for some anticipated event
members.speakLineEn: Sentinel sites detect outbreaks early.
members.speakLineZh: 哨兵站點及早偵測疫情。

members.speakLineEn: Consensus can lag behind better evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 共識可能落後更好證據。

members.senseAnchor: intended to interest, excite, or shock people
members.speakLineEn: Sensational abstracts travel farther than careful ones.
members.speakLineZh: 聳動摘要比謹慎摘要傳更遠。

members.speakLineEn: Call speculation nonsense when it wears a proof costume.
members.speakLineZh: 投機穿上證明外衣時就叫它胡說。

members.speakLineEn: Repeated crises can desensitize audiences to risk.
members.speakLineZh: 反覆危機使觀眾對風險不敏感。

members.speakLineEn: Unpaid reviewing breeds resentment.
members.speakLineZh: 無酬審稿滋生怨恨。

members.speakLineEn: Extrasensory claims need extraordinary tests.
members.speakLineZh: 超感官宣稱需要非凡檢驗。

members.speakLineEn: Report the analysis sequence before peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 偷看前先報告分析序列。

members.speakLineEn: Underpowered studies have scientific consequence.
members.speakLineZh: 檢定力不足有科學後果。

members.speakLineEn: Subsequent replications failed to confirm.
members.speakLineZh: 隨後複現未能確認。

members.speakLineEn: Three consecutive nulls lowered confidence.
members.speakLineZh: 連續三次虛無降低信心。

members.senseAnchor: conduct a prosecution in a court of law; bring a criminal action against (in a trial)
members.speakLineEn: Agencies can prosecute data fraud.
members.speakLineZh: 機關可起訴資料詐欺。

members.speakLineEn: Do not persecute whistleblowers.
members.speakLineZh: 不要迫害吹哨者。

members.senseAnchor: attempting to win favor from influential people by flattery; attentive in an ingratiating or servile manner
members.speakLineEn: Obsequious citing of celebrities weakens peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 諂媚引用名人削弱同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: Execute the preregistered plan without silent swaps.
members.speakLineZh: 執行預註冊計畫、勿沉默替換。

members.speakLineEn: Segue from methods to limits without hype.
members.speakLineZh: 從方法平滑接到限制，勿炒作。

members.speakLineEn: That slogan is a policy non sequitur.
members.speakLineZh: 那句口號是政策上的不接邏輯。

members.speakLineEn: Use sequential analysis only with alpha spending.
members.speakLineZh: 序列分析須配合 α 消耗。

members.speakLineEn: Blind pursuit of significance wastes cohorts.
members.speakLineZh: 盲目追求顯著性浪費世代。

clusters.hook: 字根 solv＝解、鬆——實驗室專管溶解問題與責任。
clusters.script: solve 解開；dissolve 溶解散去。resolve 下決心解開／決議；absolve 解除罪責。soluble 可溶，solvent 溶劑／有償債力。solution 解方；irresolute 猶豫不解。resolute 堅決；dissolute 放蕩無約束像道德溶解。

dissolute＝放蕩，不是 dissolve 的簡單形容詞

members.speakLineEn: Solve identification before claiming causation.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱因果前先解決識別問題。

members.speakLineEn: Trust can dissolve after one opaque correction.
members.speakLineZh: 一次不透明勘誤就能溶解信任。

members.speakLineEn: Resolve disputes with shared code, not status.
members.speakLineZh: 用共享程式碼解決爭議，非地位。

members.senseAnchor: grant remission of a sin to; let off the hook
members.speakLineEn: A disclaimer does not absolve sloppy measurement.
members.speakLineZh: 免責聲明不解脫草率測量。

members.speakLineEn: Not every conflict is soluble by more data.
members.speakLineZh: 不是每個衝突都能靠更多資料溶解。

members.senseAnchor: a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances; a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
members.speakLineEn: A solvent explanation dissolves the paradox.
members.speakLineZh: 有力解釋能溶解悖論。

members.speakLineEn: The solution was narrower inclusion criteria.
members.speakLineZh: 解方是更窄的納入標準。

members.senseAnchor: uncertain how to act or proceed
members.speakLineEn: Irresolute leadership stalls preregistration norms.
members.speakLineZh: 猶豫領導拖延預註冊規範。

members.speakLineEn: Be resolute about sharing negative results.
members.speakLineZh: 對分享陰性結果要堅決。

members.speakLineEn: A dissolute citation culture ignores primary sources.
members.speakLineZh: 放蕩的引用文化忽略一手來源。

members.speakLineEn: Pass a resolution requiring data deposits.
members.speakLineZh: 通過要求寄存資料的決議。

members.speakLineEn: Some ethical trade-offs remain insoluble.
members.speakLineZh: 有些倫理取捨仍然無解。

members.speakLineZh: 同儕審查者先審視方法再看結果。

members.speakLineEn: Circumspect claims survive hostile reading.
members.speakLineZh: 周密的宣稱更能扛住敵意閱讀。

members.speakLineEn: The gap in the data is conspicuous.
members.speakLineZh: 資料中的缺口非常顯眼。

members.speakLineEn: Media spectacle can replace sober analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 媒體奇觀可能取代冷靜分析。

members.speakLineEn: In retrospect, the warning signs were clear.
members.speakLineZh: 事後回顧，警訊其實很清楚。

members.speakLineEn: The prospect of replication motivated caution.
members.speakLineZh: 可複現的前景促使人們謹慎。

members.speakLineEn: Despicable tactics undermine public trust.
members.speakLineZh: 可鄙手段破壞公眾信任。

members.speakLineEn: In one respect, the critics are right.
members.speakLineZh: 就某一方面而言，批評者是對的。

members.speakLineEn: Democracy suffers when citizens remain spectators.
members.speakLineZh: 公民若只當旁觀者，民主會受損。

members.speakLineEn: Opinions fall across a wide spectrum.
members.speakLineZh: 意見落在寬廣光譜上。

members.speakLineEn: Suspicious patterns warrant a second look.
members.speakLineZh: 可疑模式值得再看一次。

members.speakLineEn: A statue of a founder is not a methods section.
members.speakLineZh: 創辦人雕像不是方法段。

members.speakLineEn: These items constitute the distress index.
members.speakLineZh: 這些題項構成困擾指數。

members.speakLineEn: Institution design shapes what evidence counts.
members.speakLineZh: 制度設計形塑何謂有效證據。

members.speakLineEn: Do not substitute rhetoric for identification.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用修辭替代識別。

members.speakLineEn: Desist from harvesting outcomes mid-stream.
members.speakLineZh: 停止中途收割結果。

members.speakLineEn: Biases persist when incentives stay misaligned.
members.speakLineZh: 誘因錯位時偏差持續。

members.speakLineEn: Fields resist reforms that threaten hierarchies.
members.speakLineZh: 領域抵抗威脅階層的改革。

members.speakLineEn: Seek stable estimates across specifications.
members.speakLineZh: 在不同設定中尋求穩定估計。

members.speakLineEn: Stability checks belong in the main text.
members.speakLineZh: 穩定性檢查應放正文。

members.speakLineEn: Establish coding reliability before analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 分析前確立編碼信度。

members.speakLineEn: State your stance on causal language explicitly.
members.speakLineZh: 明確陳述對因果語言的立場。

members.speakLineEn: Paywalls remain an obstacle to synthesis.
members.speakLineZh: 付費牆仍是綜整障礙。

members.speakLineEn: Adopt reporting standards early.

members.speakLineEn: Cite the statute, not a blog summary.
members.speakLineZh: 引用成文法，不是部落格摘要。

members.speakLineZh: 選題目前先定義構念。

members.speakLineEn: Protocols instruct assistants on coding edge cases.
members.speakLineZh: 流程指示助理如何編碼邊界案例。

members.speakLineEn: One leak can destroy years of trust.
members.speakLineZh: 一次洩漏可毀掉多年信任。

members.speakLineEn: Missing metadata obstructs reuse.
members.speakLineZh: 缺中繼資料阻礙再利用。

members.speakLineEn: Argument structure should be visible in headings.
members.speakLineZh: 論證結構應在標題可見。

members.speakLineEn: Data infrastructure is part of scientific capital.
members.speakLineZh: 資料基礎設施是科學資本。

members.speakLineEn: Historians reconstruct events from partial archives.
members.speakLineZh: 史家從殘缺檔案重建事件。

members.speakLineEn: Restructure the paper around one sharp question.
members.speakLineZh: 圍繞一個尖銳問題重整論文。

members.speakLineEn: That legal construction stretches the text.
members.speakLineZh: 該法律解釋過度拉伸文本。

members.speakLineEn: Destructive criticism without alternatives stalls fields.
members.speakLineZh: 只有破壞無替代的批評讓領域停滯。

members.speakLineEn: Failed replications can be instructive.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗複現可以有啟發。

members.senseAnchor: structure consisting of the part of a ship above the main deck
members.speakLineEn: Do not confuse rhetorical superstructure with identification.
members.speakLineZh: 别把修辭上層建築當成識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: Validate the instrument before scaling the survey.
members.speakLineZh: 放大調查前先驗證工具。

members.speakLineEn: Paywalls remain an obstruction to cumulative work.
members.speakLineZh: 付費牆仍是累積工作的障礙。

members.speakLineEn: Structural reforms beat one-off trainings.
members.speakLineZh: 結構改革勝過一次性訓練。

members.speakLineEn: Tenacious anomalies deserve another look.
members.speakLineZh: 頑強異常值得再看。

members.senseAnchor: to refrain from something by one's own choice
members.speakLineEn: Several members abstained from the vote.
members.speakLineZh: 數名成員投票棄權。

members.speakLineEn: Retain raw logs for auditability.
members.speakLineZh: 保留原始紀錄以便稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Maintain the same coding rules across waves.
members.speakLineZh: 各波次維持同一編碼規則。

members.speakLineEn: The model cannot contain every contextual factor.
members.speakLineZh: 模型無法裝下所有脈絡因素。

members.speakLineEn: Obtain consent before linking records.
members.speakLineZh: 連結紀錄前先取得同意。

members.speakLineEn: Can the budget sustain longitudinal follow-up?
members.speakLineZh: 預算撐得起縱貫追蹤嗎？

members.senseAnchor: be relevant to; be a part or attribute of
members.speakLineEn: Only variables that pertain to the hypothesis stay in.
members.speakLineZh: 只留與假說相關的變項。

members.speakLineEn: Think of a theory as a tenant in the house of evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 把理論想成證據之屋的承租人。

members.senseAnchor: the term during which some position is held; the right to hold property; part of an ancient hierarchical system of holding lands
members.speakLineEn: Tenure incentives can shape risk-taking in research.
members.speakLineZh: 終身職誘因會形塑研究冒險。

members.senseAnchor: based on sound reasoning or evidence
members.speakLineEn: Is the causal claim tenable under selection?
members.speakLineZh: 選擇偏差下因果主張站得住嗎？

members.speakLineEn: That reading becomes untenable once dates conflict.
members.speakLineZh: 日期衝突後該解讀站不住。

members.speakLineEn: Attention is a scarce resource in crowded literatures.
members.speakLineZh: 擁擠文獻裡注意力是稀缺資源。

members.speakLineEn: Results may not travel across continents without adaptation.
members.speakLineZh: 結果跨大陸未必不經適應就成立。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological detention of papers harms learning speed.
members.speakLineZh: 論文方法上的『扣留』傷害學習速度。

members.speakLineZh: 宣稱持久性前先延長追蹤窗。

members.senseAnchor: maintain or assert; have an argument about something
members.speakLineEn: Authors contend that bias is bounded.
members.speakLineZh: 作者主張偏差有界。

members.senseAnchor: become wider; cause to expand as it by internal pressure
members.speakLineEn: Hype can distend expectations beyond evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 炒作會把期望脹到超過證據。

members.speakLineEn: A tense deadline tempts cutting corners.
members.speakLineZh: 緊張期限誘使抄捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: There is productive tension between speed and rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 速度與嚴謹之間有生產性張力。

members.speakLineEn: Intense scrutiny should be fair, not theatrical.
members.speakLineZh: 強烈檢視應公平而非作秀。

members.senseAnchor: appearing as such but not necessarily so; represented or appearing as such; pretended
members.speakLineEn: The ostensible reason masked a funding conflict.
members.speakLineZh: 表面理由掩蓋資助利益衝突。

members.speakLineEn: Attend to missingness patterns early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早注意缺失模式。

members.speakLineEn: Do not pretend uncertainty is settled.
members.speakLineZh: 不要假裝不確定性已解決。

members.speakLineEn: Extensive robustness checks beat a single star.
members.speakLineZh: 廣泛穩健檢查勝過單一星號。

members.speakLineEn: There is a tendency to overfit narratives.
members.speakLineZh: 有對敘事過度擬合的傾向。

members.speakLineEn: A tensioned debate clarified operational definitions.
members.speakLineZh: 拉緊的辯論釐清操作型定義。

members.speakLineZh: 不透明前處理招致不信。

members.speakLineEn: Ambiguous items destroy interrater reliability.
members.speakLineZh: 模稜題項摧毀評分者信度。

members.speakLineEn: Vague hypotheses cannot fail.
members.speakLineZh: 含糊假說不會失敗。

members.speakLineEn: Abstruse prose is not rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 深奧難解文筆≠嚴謹。

members.senseAnchor: difficult to penetrate; incomprehensible to one of ordinary understanding or knowledge
members.speakLineEn: Recondite citations should still be findable.
members.speakLineZh: 隱僻引用仍應可找到。

members.speakLineEn: Make implicit assumptions explicit.
members.speakLineZh: 把隱含假設說明白。

members.senseAnchor: free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression; the quality of clear water
members.speakLineEn: Clarity is a ethical duty in consent.
members.speakLineZh: 同意書裡清晰是倫理義務。

members.speakLineEn: A nebula of buzzwords is not a theory.
members.speakLineZh: 術語星雲不是理論。

members.speakLineEn: Crystal-clear stopping rules prevent peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 水晶般清楚的停止規則防偷看。

members.speakLineEn: Muddy contrasts weaken identification stories.
members.speakLineZh: 混濁對照削弱識別故事。

members.senseAnchor: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
members.speakLineEn: A sycophant praises power, not evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 諂媚者歌頌的是權力，不是證據。

members.senseAnchor: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage; try to gain favor by cringing or flattering
members.speakLineEn: He dismissed the aide as a political toady.
members.speakLineZh: 他把那名助理斥為政治馬屁精。

members.speakLineEn: Junior analysts should not fawn over every fashion in theory.
members.speakLineZh: 初級分析師不該對每個理論時尚巴結奉承。

members.speakLineEn: An arrogant tone can sink an otherwise sound argument.
members.speakLineZh: 傲慢語氣可能毁掉本來站得住的論證。

members.speakLineEn: Her supercilious smile dismissed the objection.
members.speakLineZh: 她目空一切的笑把異議掃掉。

members.senseAnchor: having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy; ; ; ; ; ; ; - W.L.Shirer
members.speakLineEn: An imperious email rarely invites collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 專橫的郵件很少帶來合作。

clusters.hook: 語義對打：坦率隊 vs 欺瞞隊——GRE 語氣超愛考。
clusters.script: 坦率隊：candid／candor 直言，sincere 真誠，veracity 真實性。欺瞞隊：guile 狡詐，duplicity 雙面，deceit／deception 欺騙，artifice 伎倆，dissemble 掩飾，feign 佯裝，pretense 偽裝。
pitfalls: dissemble＝掩饰真意，不是 disassemble 拆卸

members.speakLineEn: Write a candid limitations section.
members.speakLineZh: 寫一段坦率的限制說明。

members.speakLineEn: Candor about uncertainty builds credibility.
members.speakLineZh: 對不確定性的坦率建立可信度。

members.speakLineEn: A sincere apology includes corrected data.
members.speakLineZh: 真誠道歉包含更正資料。

members.speakLineEn: Check the veracity of secondary citations.
members.speakLineZh: 核對二手引用的真實性。

members.speakLineEn: Marketing guile has no place in abstracts.
members.speakLineZh: 行銷狡詐不該出現在摘要。

members.speakLineEn: Duplicity in preregistration destroys trust.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊口是心非摧毀信任。

members.senseAnchor: the quality of being fraudulent; a misleading falsehood
members.speakLineEn: Statistical deceit often hides in silent exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 統計欺騙常藏在沉默排除。

members.speakLineEn: Deception in human subjects needs ethics review.
members.speakLineZh: 人體研究欺瞞需倫理審查。

members.senseAnchor: a deceptive maneuver (especially to avoid capture)
members.speakLineEn: Rhetorical artifice cannot replace identification.
members.speakLineZh: 修辭伎倆不能取代識別策略。

members.senseAnchor: make believe with the intent to deceive; hide under a false appearance
members.speakLineEn: Do not dissemble about conflicting interests.
members.speakLineZh: 不要掩飾利益衝突。

members.senseAnchor: to give a false appearance of
members.speakLineEn: Feign ignorance and you train bad incentives.
members.speakLineZh: 佯裝無知會訓練壞誘因。

members.speakLineEn: Drop the pretense that all findings were predicted.
members.speakLineZh: 放下『全部結果皆預測』的偽裝。

clusters.hook: 語義對打：公開可見 vs 偷偷摸摸——考場超愛對照。
clusters.script: 公開隊：overt 公開，patent／manifest 明顯，transparent 透明。隱密隊：covert 隱蔽，clandestine 祕密，surreptitious／furtive 偷偷摸摸，latent／occult 潛藏，stealth 隱身。

members.speakLineEn: Overt preregistration beats private plans.
members.speakLineZh: 公開預註冊勝過私下計畫。

members.senseAnchor: a flock of coots; a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something
members.speakLineEn: Covert multiple testing inflates false positives.
members.speakLineZh: 隱蔽多重檢定膨脹偽陽性。

members.speakLineEn: Clandestine data edits should be impossible.
members.speakLineZh: 暗中改資料應不可能。

members.senseAnchor: marked by quiet and caution and secrecy; taking pains to avoid being observed; conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods
members.speakLineEn: Surreptitious outcome switching is misconduct.
members.speakLineZh: 偷偷更換結局變項是不端。

members.senseAnchor: marked by quiet and caution and secrecy; taking pains to avoid being observed; secret and sly or sordid; ; - A.L.Guerard
members.speakLineEn: Furtive glances at interim results bias stopping.
members.speakLineZh: 鬼祟偷看期中結果扭曲停損。

members.senseAnchor: a document granting an inventor sole rights to an invention; an official document granting a right or privilege
members.speakLineEn: The flaw was patent in the raw scatterplot.
members.speakLineZh: 缺陷在原始散點圖上很明顯。

members.senseAnchor: a customs document listing the contents put on a ship or plane; provide evidence for; stand as proof of; show by one's behavior, attitude, or external attributes
members.speakLineEn: Bias became manifest after stratification.
members.speakLineZh: 分層後偏差顯現。

members.speakLineEn: Latent classes need strong identification.
members.speakLineZh: 潛在類別需要強識別。

members.senseAnchor: supernatural forces and events and beings collectively; supernatural practices and techniques
members.speakLineEn: Do not treat statistical noise as occult wisdom.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把統計噪音當隱秘智慧。

members.speakLineEn: Stealth revisions without changelogs erode trust.
members.speakLineZh: 無變更紀錄的隱密修訂侵蝕信任。

clusters.hook: 語義對打：僵硬不彎 vs 可塑可彎——人格與制度語氣都考。
clusters.script: 僵固隊：rigid／inflexible／adamant／obdurate／intransigent。彈性隊：pliable／malleable／supple／yielding／elastic／flexible。記：協議要「剛夠清楚」，方法要「柔能修正」。

members.speakLineEn: Rigid prereg is good; rigid denial of error is not.
members.speakLineZh: 僵硬預註冊好；僵硬否認錯誤不好。

members.speakLineEn: Inflexible journals delay corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 不知變通的期刊拖延勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Stay adamant about data integrity.
members.speakLineZh: 對資料誠信要堅決。

members.senseAnchor: stubbornly persistent in wrongdoing; showing unfeeling resistance to tender feelings
members.speakLineEn: Obdurate refusal to share blocks science.
members.speakLineZh: 執迷拒共享阻擋科學。

members.senseAnchor: impervious to pleas, persuasion, requests, reason; ; - W.Churchill
members.speakLineEn: Intransigent positions stall consortia.
members.speakLineZh: 不妥協立場拖延聯盟。

members.senseAnchor: susceptible to being led or directed; capable of being shaped or bent or drawn out
members.speakLineEn: Pliable criteria invite p-hacking.
members.speakLineZh: 柔韌到亂的標準誘發 p 操弄。

members.speakLineEn: Constructs are malleable—define them.
members.speakLineZh: 構念可塑——請定義。

members.speakLineEn: Supple designs adapt without cheating.
members.speakLineZh: 靈活設計能適應而不作弊。

members.senseAnchor: a verbal act of admitting defeat; the act of conceding or yielding
members.speakLineEn: Yielding to evidence is a virtue.
members.speakLineZh: 向證據屈服是美德。

members.speakLineEn: Keep timelines elastic for audits.
members.speakLineZh: 為稽核保留彈性時程。

members.speakLineEn: Flexible analysis plans must be declared.
members.speakLineZh: 靈活分析計畫必須事先聲明。

members.speakLineEn: Adaptable teams version their protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 能適應的團隊為規程做版本。

clusters.hook: 一邊痛到倒吸涼氣說不出話，一邊嘎嚕嚕叫不停。
clusters.script: 會議室左排 taciturn、reticent、laconic——能不說就不說；右排 loquacious、garrulous、verbose——停不下來。
pitfalls: reticent 強調『不願透露』；taciturn 強調『生性少話』
loquacious 中性偏多話；garrulous 更嫌喋喋

members.speakLineEn: The taciturn witness answered in monosyllables.
members.speakLineZh: 沉默的證人只用單音節回答。

members.senseAnchor: inclined to be silent or uncommunicative in speech
members.speakLineEn: She remained reticent about her funding sources.
members.speakLineZh: 她對資金來源仍不輕易透露。

members.speakLineEn: His laconic reply ended the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 他言簡意賅的回覆結束了討論。

members.speakLineEn: A loquacious narrator can bury the plot.
members.speakLineZh: 滔滔不絕的敘事者可能把情節埋掉。

members.speakLineEn: The garrulous memoir digresses endlessly.
members.speakLineZh: 這本喋喋不休的回憶錄沒完没了地離題。

members.senseAnchor: using or containing too many words
members.speakLineEn: Cut verbose transitions; keep the claim sharp.
members.speakLineZh: 刪掉冗長過渡，讓論點保持鋒利。

members.speakLineEn: The irascible professor dismissed soft questions.
members.speakLineZh: 暴躁教授直接打發軟問題。

members.speakLineEn: Peevish objections rarely improve the draft.
members.speakLineZh: 壞脾氣的反對很少能改好草稿。

members.speakLineEn: An affable chair kept the panel constructive.
members.speakLineZh: 和藹的主席讓座談保持建設性。

members.senseAnchor: diffusing warmth and friendliness; of or relating to the chin or median part of the lower jaw

members.speakLineZh: 他溫和的語氣化解了敵意審稿人。

members.speakLineEn: Amiable colleagues still need clear standards.
members.speakLineZh: 親切同事依然需要清楚標準。
